1. Engagement Scope

The scope of this review was to validate the accuracy and completeness of Bastion Workforce Solutions's EEO-1 Component 2 pay data submission for the 2015 reporting cycle. The assessment involved reconciling source payroll and HRIS data for 152 employees against the final submission file.

2. Methodology

The methodology for this review included an analysis of {org}'s insurance coverage for employment-related liabilities (EPLI), assessing policy limits and exclusions in the context of the compliance risks identified in this report.

4. Detailed Findings
OCA-1323-001INFORMATIONALDEFERRED
Observation

Mental Health Parity (MHPAEA) non-quantitative treatment limitation (NQTL) analysis is incomplete for the current plan year

Corrective Action Required

The process for identifying the median employee will be enhanced to include a statistical sampling approach, with the methodology and results documented and presented to the Audit Committee.

Management Response

The finding is accepted. We have implemented a manual control as an interim solution while a permanent system fix is being developed. The manual control is performed daily by the compliance team.

Owner: Account Executive • Due: 2015-11-28
OCA-6620-002LOWDEFERRED
Observation

10b5-1 trading plan for 152 executives lacks required cooling-off period under amended rules

Corrective Action Required

Conduct a self-audit of all I-9 forms for employees hired in the past 12 months. Correct all identified errors and provide remedial training to all staff responsible for I-9 verification.

Management Response

We concur with the finding. The process has been redesigned, and user acceptance testing is scheduled for the week of 2015-07-11. Full implementation will follow immediately after successful testing.

Owner: Event Planner • Due: 2015-10-28
OCA-1186-003INFORMATIONALREMEDIATED
Observation

Personal Health Information (PHI) transmitted via unencrypted email for 152 benefits claims

Corrective Action Required

The 401(k) plan fiduciary committee shall formalize its vendor review process, including the issuance of RFPs and documentation of the selection rationale for all plan service providers.

Management Response

This finding has been superseded by a subsequent internal audit finding which addresses the same root cause with a more comprehensive corrective action plan. We request this finding be closed and tracked under the new internal audit reference number.

Owner: Director of Enterprise Partnerships • Due: 2015-09-28
OCA-5507-004LOWREMEDIATED
Observation

Equity grant documentation incomplete for awards issued during the review period

Corrective Action Required

Establish a formal policy recoupment tracking log and assign ownership to a designated compliance officer. All recoupment events must be documented within 30 days of trigger event and reported quarterly to the Audit Committee.

Management Response

The finding is valid. A budget of $152K has been approved to procure the necessary technology to automate this control. Implementation is projected to take 47 weeks.

Owner: Senior Manager of Data Analytics • Due: 2015-09-28
OCA-8813-005LOWMONITORING
Observation

Union information requests for bargaining unit data were not fulfilled within the required timeframe

Corrective Action Required

A senior executive will be formally designated at each company establishment to be responsible for the review and certification of the annual OSHA 300A summary.

Management Response

Corrective action is complete. The revised policy was approved by the Board on 2015-07-11 and has been communicated to all employees. A copy of the communication and the approved policy is attached as evidence.

Owner: Director of Legislative Affairs • Due: 2015-11-28
